name: Lennox International
description: Lennox makes heating, cooling and refrigeration equipment: residential furnaces, air conditioners and heat pumps (Lennox, Armstrong Air, Ducane and others) sold mainly to dealers and contractors for replacement and new construction in North America, and commercial rooftop, applied and refrigeration systems sold to building owners and contractors. It also wholesales HVAC parts and supplies through a network of Lennox Stores in the US and Canada. Home Comfort Solutions is 64 percent of 2025 sales and Building Climate Solutions 36 percent. Commercial earnings were up 9 percent in 2025 while residential profit fell 4 percent on 7 percent lower sales.

sub.name: Heating, cooling, elevators, lighting and building controls

employees.note: About 12,900 people, mainly in the US (about 8,500) and Mexico.

businessLines.name: Home Comfort Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells furnaces, air conditioners, heat pumps, packaged systems and indoor-air-quality products plus replacement parts mainly through dealers, distributors and its own Lennox Stores to residential replacement (the bulk) and new-construction markets in North America; repeat parts and supplies sales ride on the installed base.

businessLines.name: Building Climate Solutions
businessLines.how: Sells commercial unitary rooftop and applied HVAC systems, controls and refrigeration equipment (condensing units, unit coolers, racks) to building owners and contractors through reps and distributors, plus installation, service, and HVAC recycling and salvage; project-based equipment sales with some recurring service.

brands.name: Lennox, Dave Lennox Signature Collection, Armstrong Air, Ducane, AirEase, Concord, MagicPak, ADP Advanced Distributor Products, Allied, Supco
brands.note: Home Comfort Solutions brands named in the 10-K; revenue by brand not disclosed

brands.name: Lennox Stores
brands.note: Network of company-operated stores in the US and Canada selling parts, supplies and equipment to contractors; store count not read

brands.name: Duro Dyne and Supco
brands.note: HVAC parts and supplies portfolio, acquisition completed October 2025; price not read.
